title: REI Reverse Engineering Workbench (REI REA)
upstream_rea_notice: REI REA is an original Rootcastle Engineering & Innovation Python workbench. The independent morluto/rea project is tracked separately in Rei-Reverse-engineer/upstream/rea and retains its own upstream provenance.

capability_states.cataloged: Listed in the 124-entry discovery registry with metadata and homepage. Does NOT imply local installation or execution support.
capability_states.path_detected: Executable name was resolved on the local machine PATH via `rei-rea tools doctor`.
capability_states.adapter_supported: Covered by one of the 11 reviewed, argument-locked static adapters requiring explicit `--allow-external` opt-in.
capability_states.tested_in_env: Verified against a reproducible local fixture in the active environment.
capability_states.planned: Documented for future provider integration (e.g., live Ghidra/IDA/JADX/Frida session control or upstream morluto/rea server).
capability_states.unsupported: Excluded from REI REA scope (e.g., autonomous exploit generation, firmware flashing, or unauthorized target interaction).

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_tools
mcp_tools.purpose: Filter 124-entry tool catalog records by tag or capability.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_doctor
mcp_tools.purpose: Inspect local PATH availability vs adapter support.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_inspect
mcp_tools.purpose: Identify format and compute SHA-256 of an authorized artifact.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_plan
mcp_tools.purpose: Produce an evidence-based specialist skill and tool routing plan.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_signals
mcp_tools.purpose: Read bounded entropy, signature, and optional string signals.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_compare
mcp_tools.purpose: Compare hashes and bounded byte differences of two files.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_case_create
mcp_tools.purpose: Initialize a hash-linked SHA-256 evidence case.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_case_verify
mcp_tools.purpose: Validate append-only case event integrity and target hash.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_investigate
mcp_tools.purpose: Run read-only cross-hash-checked static analysis pipeline (<= 64 MiB).

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_deep
mcp_tools.purpose: Parse bounded PE, ELF, and WebAssembly v1 structural headers/tables.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_diff
mcp_tools.purpose: Compare parsed binary structures across two artifact versions.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_case_search
mcp_tools.purpose: Search an explicitly indexed local SQLite forensic casebook.

mcp_tools.name: rei_rea_bundle_verify
mcp_tools.purpose: Verify checksums of an exported metadata-only evidence bundle.

skills.name: rei-electron-and-js

skills.name: rei-evidence-ledger

skills.name: rei-firmware-and-iot

skills.name: rei-mobile-runtime

skills.name: rei-native-binaries

skills.name: rei-rea-orchestrator

skills.name: rei-reconstruction-parity

skills.name: rei-wasm-and-managed

skills.name: rei-web-and-protocols
